theme.mode: Light-Dominant with High Contrast Dark Accents

typography.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900

printable_student_id_card.container_class: w-[340px] h-[215px] rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl relative border border-slate-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-600 via-sky-700 to-slate-900 text-white p-4 font-sans select-none

front_side.photo_box: w-20 h-24 rounded-lg border-2 border-white/80 object-cover shadow-md bg-slate-800
front_side.qr_box: w-16 h-16 bg-white p-1 rounded-md border border-slate-300 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center

rules: 1. Kartu ini wajib dibawa selama berada di lingkungan sekolah.
2. Digunakan untuk Presensi QR Code & Peminjaman Perpustakaan/Inventaris.
3. Apabila hilang/rusak, segera lapor ke Tata Usaha.
back_side.signature_area: Tanda Tangan Kepala Sekolah + Cap Basah Digital

printable_student_id_card.print_styles: @media print { body * { visibility: hidden; } .printable-id-card, .printable-id-card * { visibility: visible; } .printable-id-card { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 85.6mm; height: 53.98mm; box-shadow: none; border: 1px solid #ccc; page-break-after: always; } }

sidebar_navigation.style: bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 w-64 min-h-screen border-r border-slate-800 flex flex-col justify-between p-4
sidebar_navigation.active_link: bg-sky-600 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-sm px-3 py-2.5 transition-all flex items-center gap-3
sidebar_navigation.inactive_link: text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-800/80 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 transition-all flex items-center gap-3

qr_attendance_scanner.scan_overlay: absolute inset-0 border-2 border-sky-400/60 rounded-xl m-12 pointer-events-none animate-pulse flex items-center justify-center text-sky-400 text-xs font-mono
qr_attendance_scanner.counter_card_present: bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm text-center
qr_attendance_scanner.counter_card_absent: bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-900 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm text-center
qr_attendance_scanner.counter_card_sick: bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm text-center
qr_attendance_scanner.counter_card_permission: bg-sky-50 border border-sky-200 text-sky-900 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm text-center

schoolgram_social_feed.post_header: flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-slate-100

osis_elections.vote_button: w-full mt-4 bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-white font-semibold py-2.5 rounded-xl shadow transition-all
